title: POST /devices/diagnostics – request
description: What the device tells the server after the server rejected a chain entry of it (chain_gap, chain_fork or bad_hmac in a push response): the device stops sending those entries, and the supervisor sees this in the report. Outside the chain, because the chain is what has gone wrong. Device token, also of a revoked device until it closes its upload; requires an Idempotency-Key header (common/idempotency-key.json). device_id must equal the token's device. Sending the same id again changes nothing. Response: 200, api/device-diagnostic.response.json.

id.description: Generated by the app, so that a retry is recognised.

entry_id.description: The first rejected entry of the response.

expected_seq.description: The rejection's expected_seq: for chain_gap the seq the server is waiting for; otherwise null.

rejected_count.description: How many entries the response rejected.

occurred_at.description: When the response arrived: its server_time.
